Hi all, thanks for joining the quarterly budget review for the Pathway team. I'm Ravi from finance. With me are Meera from product and Arjun from engineering. We have three things today: cloud hosting costs, the analytics tool renewal, and hiring for next quarter.

First, cloud hosting. Arjun, the bill went from eight thousand two hundred dollars in January to eleven thousand five hundred in February. What happened? Most of it is the new search service. We run the search index on large instances and we never turned on autoscaling. At night traffic drops by eighty percent but we keep paying for full capacity. If we turn on autoscaling and move logs to cold storage after thirty days, I estimate we get back to around nine thousand a month. Okay, that's a clear yes from me. We agreed to enable autoscaling for the search service and move logs older than thirty days to cold storage. Arjun, when can that be done? I'll have autoscaling on by the end of this month, and the log policy the week after.

Second, the analytics tool. The current contract with Insightly is twenty-four thousand dollars a year and it renews on the first of May. Meera, do we still need it? We use maybe thirty percent of it. Mostly funnels and retention charts. There is a cheaper option, Metricbase, at around nine thousand a year, but migrating our dashboards would take engineering time, maybe three weeks. I don't want to decide this without seeing a proper comparison. So no decision on the analytics tool today. Meera will prepare a comparison of Insightly and Metricbase, including the migration effort, by the fifteenth of April. And we need to know whether Insightly will offer a discount if we sign for two years. That's an open question. I'll ask our account manager.

Third, hiring. Product has asked for one more mobile engineer next quarter. Arjun, why? We're behind on Android. Almost all our crash issues are on older Android versions and we have only one Android specialist. Okay. The budget for next quarter has room for one engineer, so the mobile engineer hire is approved, starting the hiring process in April. What about the QA lead role that's been empty since Rohan left? That one is not in the budget. We'd have to drop something else. So the QA lead position is still unresolved. We need to decide whether to fund it by delaying the analytics migration or by asking for more budget. Let's bring that back next month.

To summarise: autoscaling and log retention for search are approved, Arjun owns them. The analytics tool decision is postponed until Meera's comparison on the fifteenth of April. One mobile engineer hire is approved for next quarter. Open questions: whether Insightly offers a two-year discount, and how to fund the QA lead position. Thanks, everyone.
